annotations.title: Polyrank AI Lab: start paper trading

description: Writes to the user's AI Lab: ask the user before calling, then pass confirm: true. Start paper trading a saved strategy: from now on every signal of its wallets is scored against the real order book (no orders, no keys, no money). The run lasts 10 days unless run_days says otherwise (a whole number of days, 1 to 90, only when the user asked for that length; null = no end, it runs until stopped). The result's ends_at is when it stops by itself (null = no end; open copies still settle after it): tell the user, and that they can change it on the run's page at polyrank.app. One active run per strategy. Needs a signed-in Polyrank account on a plan with the AI Lab (every paid plan, from Pro Trader: https://polyrank.app/pricing).

confirm.description: Required: true, and only after the user agreed to this call in the conversation.

run_days.description: How many days the run lasts (default 10); null = no end, it runs until the user stops it.
